newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian opposition leader Nano freed from jail.
newsitem.headline: Albanian opposition leader Nano freed from jail.

text.p: Albanian opposition leader Fatos Nano was released from jail on Thursday along with other prisoners because their safety could no longer be guaranteed, Justice Minister Spartak Ngjela said.
Nano has been in jail for nearly four years after being convicted on corruption charges that the opposition said were politically motivated.

The minister of the new all-party government, sworn in only hours earlier, said all prisoners apart from those serving life sentences in a top-security prison in northern Albania had been released, including Nano.
Nano's wife, reached by telephone, said she had heard the report but added that her husband had not yet returned home.
The minister said there were clashes in a Tirana prison on Wednesday night and that the situation in all prisons was "very grave".
Nano, who was briefly prime minister in 1991, has been mentioned as a possible new leader to replace President Sali Berisha, whose resignation is demanded by rebels in the south of the country.
